preamble: A voiceless retroflex fricative [ʂ] becomes voiced [ʐ] before a voiced obstruent. In Russian this is regressive voicing assimilation within a phrase.

examples.note: 'you would give': ш [ʂ] assimilates to the voiced б.

sources: Timberlake, A. (2004). A Reference Grammar of Russian. Cambridge University Press.
Padgett, J. (2002). Russian voicing assimilation, final devoicing, and the problem of [v].
